grader.scenario: Double charge for pay-per-view boxing match on TV set-top box bill
grader.notes: Poor customer service call marked by agent rudeness, victim-blaming, deflection of ownership, repeated questioning, and failure to resolve monetary dispute, while maintaining baseline empathy acknowledgment.

items.name: Branding and Survey Check
items.evidence: Agent opened with 'Thank you for calling S-Net TV billing customer services' at [00:00] and closed with 'Thank you for choosing S-Net' in final lines.

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: Hold was announced with bear with me and thanked upon return without unmanaged dead air.

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: Verified full postal address and security PIN within the first 240 seconds.

items.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
items.evidence: Agent addressed customer as Kasim throughout the call.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: Agent acknowledged double-charge concern at [02:40] ('I understand that double charges cause immediate concern, Kasim. Let us examine the duplicate token.') and customer had no unhandled outbursts.

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: Agent never restated the duplicate charge problem in his own words.

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: Agent asked for TV box serial number at turn 23 despite customer providing SNET-TV-99120 at turn 3.

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: Agent repeatedly deflected ownership telling customer to use mobile app or file chargeback with his bank.

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: Agent insulted customer at [03:40]: 'Well if you had actually waited... instead of repeatedly hammering the remote control, you wouldn't have generated duplicate transactions.'

items.name: Probing
items.evidence: Agent asked relevant questions regarding statement descriptions and purchase timestamps.

items.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
items.evidence: Duplicate charge was not refunded, customer disconnected expressing intention to dispute through bank.
